text_block_list.text:
That takes care of the loose threads...
Looks like the decorations won't come off either...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"—Phew.
This will make it in time for the next race."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry!
I'll be more careful from now on...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She does seem truly remorseful.
There's no use crying over spilled milk, so I'll have her give it her all again starting tomorrow.
